title: On Making the whole frame in one week
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：make　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 make 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the director ① made the whole frame in one week in the rain, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② makes the whole frame in one week without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ make the whole frame in one week at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ made the whole frame in one week before — a line in the poster for August 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Making the whole frame in one week in the rain, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ make the same mistake twice without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Make the same mistake twice at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ makes the same mistake twice in the rain every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ made the whole frame in one week again when nobody else would.

⑩ To make the whole frame in one week, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody makes the whole frame in one week without complaint again and somebody must make the whole frame in one week in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 制作（一般过去式 made the whole frame in one week：1970 年导演头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 制作（一般现在 makes the whole frame in one week：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 制作（不定式 to make the whole frame in one week：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 制作（过去完成时 had made the whole frame in one week：1964 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 制作（动名词 making the whole frame in one week 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使（make the same mistake twice：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使重犯同样的错误）
G. v. 使（make the same mistake twice：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 制作（后段两处：新来的演员照例 makes the same mistake twice，而母亲又一次 made the whole frame in one week）

make 意为“制作”，自那以后导演毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 makes。
make 意为“制作”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯制作一周之内做完了整个架子”，此处为不定式 to make the whole frame in one week。
make 意为“制作”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人制作过，故用过去完成时 had made。
make 意为“制作”，导演说“制作一周之内做完了整个架子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 making the whole frame in one week 作主语。
make 意为“使”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使重犯同样的错误”，should ever 之后用原形 make the same mistake twice。
make 意为“使”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使重犯同样的错误（make the same mistake twice at once），以后再也不要提起。
make 意为“制作”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例使重犯同样的错误，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 makes。
make 意为“制作”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨制作一周之内做完了整个架子，用一般过去式 made 叙述。
make 意为“制作”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要制作一周之内做完了整个架子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 make 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the director made the whole frame in one week in the rain, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director makes the whole frame in one week without complaint whenever the theatre asks.
Making the whole frame in one week in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever make the same mistake twice without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre makes the same mistake twice in the rain every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother made the whole frame in one week again, and the theatre remembered that half.
